glance: Saturday afternoon marks the 13th meeting between Notre Dame and Syracuse. The Irish lead the all-time series 9-3-0 and are 2-0 against the Orange under Marcus Freeman.
Saturday will mark the fifth consecutive meeting in which at least one team has been ranked, a streak that began in 2018.
Marcus Freeman and Fran Brown will meet for the second time as head coaches.

Before becoming head coaches, Freeman and Brown were on opposing staffs twice, first when Freeman was an assistant at Kent State while Brown was on staff at Temple in 2011 and again when Freeman was an assistant at Cincinnati while Brown was an assistant at Temple in 2019.
Notre Dame is 25-4 against current ACC opponents under Dick Corbett Head Coach Marcus Freeman.
In their most recent meeting, Notre Dame defeated Syracuse 70-7 on Senior Day at Notre Dame Stadium on Nov. 22, 2025.
